spans.s:
विप् 1. विप् [cf. rts. वप्, व्यप्], cl. 10.
P. वेपयति (Ved. also विपयति), -यि-
तुम्, to throw, cast; to strew, scatter, (Ṛg-veda

. विपयन्ति बर्हिः, they strew the sacred
grass; Sāy. = स्तृणन्ति.)

विप् 2. विप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. (perhaps con-
nected with rt. 1. विप्, in the sense ‘pouring out,’ ‘ut-
tering’), uttering hymns of praise, praising; (प्), m.
a singer of hymns, praiser; = विप्र; = मेधाविन्,
a wise man; (प्), f. praise, a hymn; a finger.
—वि-
पश्-चित्, त्, त्, त्, excogitating praise or hymns of praise
(Ved.); wise, learned, prudent; (त्), m. a Ṛṣi, sage,
teacher, learned Brāhman (= मेधाविन्, Naigh.

III.
15

); N. of the Indra in the second Manv-antara.
—विपो-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. singing hymns.

विप, अस्, m., Ved. a praiser (= मेधाविन्, ac-
cording to Naigh.
III. 15

); (आ), f. = वाच् (according
to Naigh.

विपा वि-पा, cl. 1. P. -पिबति, &c., -पातुम्,
to drink at different times; to drink up.
वीपा वीपा, f. lightning.
विप्र, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
II. 28

. fr. rt.
वप्, ‘to strew;’ cf. rt. 1. विप्), an utterer of praise,
singer of hymns, Ṛṣi, praiser, poet, any one skilled
in hymns; a Brāhman, priest; a sage, seer, wise
man (= मेधाविन्, Naigh.
III. 15

); a foot of four
short syllables (in prosody); N. of a son of Dhruva;
of a son of Śrutañ-jaya.
—विप्र-कन्या, f. a Brāh-
man girl, maiden of the sacerdotal class, Brāhmaṇī.
—विप्र-काष्ठ, अम्, n. the cotton tree (= तूल-
वृक्ष).
—विप्र-चूडामणि, इस्, m. ‘Brāhman-
jewel,’ an excellent Brāhman.
—विप्र-जन, अस्, m.
a person of the sacerdotal caste, a Brāhman; a com-
pany of Brāhmans.
—विप्र-जूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
impelled or urged by priests, invoked by the wise,
(Sāy. = मेधाविभिर् ऋत्विग्भिः प्रेरितः, Ṛg-
veda

.)
—विप्र-जूति, इस्, m., N. of the author
of Ṛg-veda

, (having the patronymic
Vātaraśana.)
—विप्र-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most
wise, wisest.
—विप्र-देव, अस्, m., N. of a leader
of the Bhāgavata sect.
—विप्र-प्रिय, अस्, m.
‘Brāhman-favourite,’ epithet of the Palāśa tree.
—विप्र-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of the author of Ṛg-
veda

-60, (having the patronymic
Gaupāyana or Laupāyana.)
—विप्र-राज्य, अम्, n.
the kingdom or sovereignty of the Brāhmans or
priests.
—विप्रर्षि (˚र-ऋषि), इस्, m. a Brāhman-
ṛṣi, a sage of the Brāhmanical class (e. g. Vasiṣṭha).
—विप्र-लोभिन्, ई, m. ‘Brāhman-enticing,’ epithet
of the Kiṅkirāta tree.
—विप्र-वचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
Ved. possessing the hymns of Ṛṣis or poets, (Sāy.
= विविध-प्रकृष्ट-वचन.)
—विप्र-समा-
गम, अस्, m. a concourse of Brāhmans.
—विप्र-
सात्, ind. to the state of a Brāhman.
—विप्र-सेवा,
f. attendance on Brāhmans, service of a Brāhman
master (Manu

).
—विप्र-स्व, अम्, n. the
property of a Brāhman.
—विप्रापवाद (˚र-अप्˚),
अस्, m. abuse of a Brāhman.
—विप्रेन्द्र (˚र-इन्˚),
अस्, m. chief of Brāhmans.

विप्र विप्र, विप्र-कन्या, &c. See p. 926,
col. 2.

विपक्त्रिम वि-पक्त्रिम, वि-पक्व. See un-
der वि-पच्.

वि-पक्त्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly matured,
ripened; fulfilled, developed, come to pass (as the
consequence of former actions).

विपक्ष वि-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, being on a
different or opposite side, opposed, adverse, contrary,
inimical; (अस्), m. an opponent, enemy, adversary,
rival; a disputant; (in grammar) an exception;
(in logic) a negative instance, a syllogism in which
the major term is not found; an instance on the
opposite side (as ‘there cannot be fire in a lake,
because there is no smoke there’).
—विपक्ष-तस्,
ind. hostilely, inimically; from a rival, (चरमं
विपक्षतः, after a rival, Kirāt.
VIII. 54

.)
—वि-
पक्ष-ता, f. or विपक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. hostility,
enmity, opposition, controversy, contradiction.
—वि-
पक्ष-भाव, अस्, m. hostile disposition, state of
hostility.
—विपक्ष-शूल, अस्, m., N. of a chief of
a sect called Ārādhya.
—विपक्षाक्रान्त (˚ष-
आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, seized by an enemy.

वि-पक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. placed or yoked on
both sides (e. g. युञ्जन्ति काम्या हरी विपक्षसा
रथे, they harness the two favourite bay horses
[of Indra] to the chariot on both sides, Ṛg-veda

विपक्षपात वि-पक्षपात, अस्, आ, अम्, free
from partizanship, impartial, indifferent; (अस्), m.
impartiality, indifference.

विपच् वि-पच्, cl. 1. P. A. -पचति, -ते,
[]
पक्तुम्, to cook thoroughly, overcook; to
roast; to dissolve by cooking or boiling, melt,
liquefy; to digest; to mature, ripen: Pass. -पच्-
यते, to be cooked or baked; to be digested; to be
completely matured or ripened; to be developed:
Caus. -पाचयति, -यितुम्, to cook thoroughly, over-
cook; to dissolve by cooking, melt, liquefy.

वि-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, cooked, dressed; ripened,
matured.

वि-पाक, अस्, m. cooking thoroughly, cooking,
dressing; ripening, maturing, ripeness, maturity;
conversion of food into a state differing from its
original one, digestion; change of state (in general);
unexpected consequence of actions, unexpected event
or occurrence, improbable result; the consequence
or result of any action either in this or in a former
birth matured by the operation of time; calamity,
distress, poverty, difficulty, embarrassment; flavour,
taste; (अस्, आ, अम्), having mature fruit, fruitful,
(Sāy. = परिपक्व-फल.)
—विपाक-विस्फूर्ज-
थु, उस्, m. the thunder or thunderbolt of the con-
sequences (of sins committed in a former birth).
विपाक वि-पाक. See under वि-पच्.

वि-पाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having unexpected consequences
or results, resulting in, followed by.

विपञ्ची वि-पञ्ची, f. (said to be fr. rt. पञ्च्
with वि), play, sport, pastime; a lute.
वि-पञ्चिका, f. a lute (= वीणा).

विपट् वि-पट्, cl. 10. P. -पाटयति, -यितुम्,
to split in two, tear open; to tear out, eradicate,
root up, destroy; to open, unfold.

वि-पाटन, अम्, n. the act of splitting in two,
tearing open, uprooting, eradication; driving away,
spoliation.
विपाटन वि-पाटन. See under वि-पट्.

वि-पाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, split or torn open, rooted up,
eradicated, destroyed.
—विपाटितारिष्ट (˚त-अर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, destroying or driving away ill luck.

विपठ् वि-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, -पठितुम्,
to read through, read.

विपण् वि-पण्, cl. 1. A. -पणते (ep. also
P. -ति), -पणितुम्, to sell; to bet.

वि-पण, अस्, m. or वि-पणन, अम्, n. sale,
contract of sale; low or petty traffic.
वि-पणत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, selling.

वि-पणि, इस्, m. f. or वि-पणी, f. a place where
things are sold, a shop, stall, fair, market, market-
place; the street of a market; any article or com-
modity for sale; traffic.
—विपणि-मध्य-ग, अस्,
आ, अम्, being in the midst of the market.

वि-पणिन्, ई, m. a dealer, trafficker, shopkeeper,
merchant.

विपत् वि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्,
to fall or break through, dash through (Ved., Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda

. वि-पतथ = विशीर्णम्
पातयथ); to fall off, fly apart, fall asunder, burst
asunder, be reft asunder, be divided or separated:
Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly off or away,
shoot off, discharge (arrows &c.); to cause to fly
apart or burst asunder; to destroy, kill.

विपथ वि-पथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a different
path, wrong way, bad road; (अस्), m., Ved. a kind
of war-chariot.
—विपथ-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going
in a wrong way or evil course.
—विपथ-यमक,
अम्, n. a kind of Yamaka, q. v., in which the parono-
masia is only at the beginning and end of the verse.

वि-पथि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. going on paths that spread
in different directions.

विपद् 1. वि-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-
तुम्, to go apart, go badly or wrongly, fail, mis-
carry; to fall into a bad state, fall into misfortune;
to be disabled or incapacitated; to perish, die; to
hinder, obstruct: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to go wrong, cause to perish, destroy, kill.

2. वि-पद्, त्, f. going wrongly, calamity, adversity,
distress, misfortune; death.
—विपत्-काल, अस्, m. a
time of calamity, season of misfortune, adversity,
—विपत्-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, resulting in misfortunes,
calamitous in result.
—विपत्-सागर, अस्, m. an
ocean of misfortunes, heavy calamity.
—विपद्-उद्-
धरण, अम्, n. or विपद्-उद्धार, अस्, m. extri-
cation from misfortune.
—विपद्-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
seized or devoured by misfortune, overtaken by or
involved in calamity.
—विपद्-दशा, f. a state of
misfortune, calamitous condition.
—विपद्-युक्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, attended with misfortune, unhappy, un-
fortunate.
—विपद्-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
misfortune, prosperous.

1. वि-पत्ति, इस्, f. going wrongly, adversity, cala-
mity, misfortune, disaster, mishap, (opposed to सम्-
[]
पत्ति); pain, agony; death, dying.
—विपत्ति-काल,
अस्, m. a season of adversity or distress.
—विपत्ति-
युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attended with misfortune, unfor-
tunate.
—विपत्ति-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from mis-
fortune, prosperous, happy.

2. वि-पत्ति, इस्, m. a distinguished or excellent
foot-soldier (= विशिष्टः पदातिः, Kirāt.
XV. 16
वि-पदा, f. misfortune, adversity, calamity, distress.

वि-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, gone wrong, fallen into
adversity or misfortune, unfortunate, afflicted, dis-
tressed; declined, failed; disabled, incapacitated;
lost, destroyed, annihilated; dead, defunct; (अस्), m.
a snake.
—विपन्नापत्य (˚न-अप्˚), आ, f. a woman
who has lost a child by abortion.

विपन्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, unfortunate; dead; de-
stroyed.

वि-पादन, अम्, n. the act of destroying, destroy-
ing, killing, destruction.

वि-पादनीय or वि-पादयितव्य or वि-पाद्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, proper to be destroyed, fit to be killed,
destructible.
वि-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, killed.

विपन्य वि-पन्य (probably fr. विपन्या
below), Nom. A. -पन्यते, &c., Ved. to praise in
various ways, praise, (Sāy. = विविधं स्तु.)
विपन्या, f., Ved. desire of praising; praise.

विपन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desirous of praising,
wishing to praise, diligent in praise, singing praises,
praising, (Sāy. = स्तोतृ.)

विपयस् वि-पयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, waterless,
destitute of water.

विपरिक्रम् वि-परि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रा-
मति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to step or walk round
or on all sides, go round, circumambulate.

वि-परिक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has shown
valour (in battle), courageous, powerful.

वि-परिक्रामम्, ind., Ved. having walked round,
going all about.

विपरिगा वि-परि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गा-
तुम्, to go over, be overturned or upset (as a cart).

विपरिच्छिद् वि-परि-च्छिद् (-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A.
-च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to cut on all sides,
cut round, cut to pieces, cut off, destroy utterly.

वि-परिच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut on all sides, cut
to pieces, cut off, utterly destroyed.
—विपरिच्छिन्न-
मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the roots cut completely
round or off, entirely uprooted.

विपरिणम् वि-परि-णम् (-नम्), Pass. -णम्-
यते, to be changed into; to undergo change or
alteration.

वि-परिणमन, अम्, n. changing, alteration, un-
dergoing change or alterations.

वि-परिणाम, अस्, m. change of state or form,
transformation, change, alteration.

वि-परिणामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, undergoing or producing
change of state or form.

विपरितप् वि-परि-तप्, cl. 4. A. or Pass.
-तप्यते, to be greatly distressed, suffer great pain.

विपरिधा वि-परि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति,
-धत्ते, -धातुम्, to exchange, change, alter.

वि-परिधाय, ind. having changed, having
changed a dress.

विपरिधाव् वि-परि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धा-
वति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run about, run in all direc-
tions; to run through, overrun.

विपरिमुच् वि-परि-मुच्, Pass. -मुच्यते, to
be freed from, be released from.

विपरिम्लै वि-परि-म्लै, cl. 1. P. A. -म्लायति,
-ते, -म्लातुम्, to fade or wither away entirely.

वि-परिम्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely faded, com-
pletely withered.

विपरिलुप् वि-परि-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्-
पति, -ते, -लोप्तुम्, to break to pieces or destroy
utterly, break up, annihilate.

वि-परिलुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, broken or destroyed
utterly, broken up.
वि-परिलोप, अस्, m. breaking or destroying utterly.

विपरिवृत् वि-परि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते,
&c., -वर्तितुम्, to turn round, revolve, move in a
circle; to roll about; to go to and fro, wander all
round, wander about; to turn round or back, return;
to be changed or altered; to surround, attend upon
(with acc.): Caus. -वर्तयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause
to turn round or revolve.

वि-परिवर्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to turn round,
causing to return; (ई), f., scil. विद्या, a magical
knowledge producing the return of any one; (अम्),
n. turning about, turning away from or back.

वि-परिवर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, wandering or
roaming about.

वि-परिवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away from or
back, reverted, averted.

वि-परिवर्त्य, ind. having turned round, having
turned away.
वि-परिवृत्ति, इस्, f. turning round, revolution.

वि-परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, turned the
wrong way, reversed, inverted, inverse, converse,
opposite, adverse, perverse, contrary, repugnant; con-
trary to what is right, wrong, contrary to rule, incor-
rect; being the reverse of anything (abl.); being in
altered or changed circumstances; acting in an oppo-
site manner, having a contrary disposition, going
asunder or in opposite directions, different; cross;
disagreeable; inauspicious, unfavourable; (आ), f. a
perverse woman; a disloyal or unchaste wife.
—वि-
परीत-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or विपरीत-कारिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, or विपरीत-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, acting in a con-
trary manner, perverse, contradictory.
—विपरीत-
क्रीडा, f., N. of the 125th chapter of the Śārṅga-
dhara-paddhati.
—विपरीत-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going
backwards, going in a contrary or reverse direction;
(इस्), f. inverse or reverse motion.
—विपरीत-चेतस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, contrary-minded, having a perverted mind
or impaired mental faculties.
—विपरीत-ता, f. or
विपरीत-त्व, अम्, n. contrariety, inversion, per-
verseness, reverse or opposite state or condition;
counterpart.
—विपरीत-पथ्या, f. a sort of metre.
—विपरीत-बोध, अस्, आ, अम्, having a perverted
understanding or intellect.
—विपरीत-रत, अम्, n.
inverted sexual intercourse.
—विपरीत-लक्षणा, f.
ironical description of an object by mentioning its
contrary properties.
—विपरीत-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, act-
ing or behaving in a contrary manner.
—विपरीता-
ख्यानकी (˚त-आख्˚), f. a sort of metre.
—विपरी-
तायन (˚त-अय्˚), अम्, n. a contrary Ayana or
progress of the sun from solstice to solstice.
—विप-
रीतायन-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, (in astronomy) situated
in contrary Ayanas.

वि-पर्यय, अस्, m. reverse, inversion, contra-
riety, (विपर्यये, on the contrary; रात्रेर् विपर्-
ययः, the contrary of night, i. e. day); inverted
order or succession, perverseness, obstruction, opposi-
tion; change, interchange, exchange, barter, (द्र-
व्य-व्˚, exchange of goods, buying and selling, trade);
morbid change, reverse of fortune, calamity, mis-
fortune, adverse fate; error, transgression, trespass;
[]
misapprehension, mistake, failure of conception; per-
verseness of disposition; change of purpose or conduct,
enmity, hostility; overthrow, destruction, annihilation.

वि-पर्याय, अस्, m. = वि-पर्यय, reverse, con-
trariety, &c.

विपरे वि-परे (-परा-इ), cl. 2. P. -परैति,
-परैतुम्, Ved. to go back again, return.

विपर्णक वि-पर्णक, अस्, m. the Palāśa tree,
Butea Frondosa.

विपर्यस् वि-पर्य्-अस् (-परि-अस्), cl. 4. A.
-अस्यते, -असितुम्, to throw or turn over, overturn,
turn the wrong way, reverse, invert; to change
about, interchange, exchange.

वि-पर्यस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, re-
verse, opposite, contrary; interchanged, inverted (in
grammar); erroneously conceived to be real.
—वि-
पर्यस्त-पुत्रा, f. a woman bearing no male chil-
dren.
—विपर्यस्त-मनश्-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing mind and actions perverted or inverted.

वि-पर्यस्य, ind. having turned over, having
inverted, having changed or exchanged.

वि-पर्यास, अस्, m. reverse, contrariety, opposi-
tion; interchange [cf. वि-पर्यय]; error, mistake,
delusion, imagining what is unreal or false to be real

वि-प्रलोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, disarranged, spoiled.

विप्रलुप् वि-प्र-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति,
-ते, -लोप्तुम्, to tear away, carry off, snatch away,
rob, plunder; to break in upon, interrupt, disturb,
confound: Pass. -लुप्यते, to be robbed or plundered.

वि-प्रलुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, snatched away, carried off,
plundered; broken in upon, interrupted, disturbed.

वि-प्रलुम्पक, अस्, इका, अम्, rapacious, exacting,
avaricious.

विप्रलुभ् वि-प्र-लुभ्, Caus. A. -लोभयते,
-यितुम्, to allure, entice, try to lead astray or deceive.

विप्रलू वि-प्र-लू, cl. 9. P. A. -लुनाति, -लु-
नीते, -लवितुम्, to cut off, sever, pluck, gather.

वि-प्रलून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, plucked off,
gathered.

विप्रवद् वि-प्र-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -व-
दते, -वदितुम्, to speak variously, be at variance
with one another, disagree.

विप्रवस् वि-प्र-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P.
-वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell at a distance, dwell abroad,
be absent: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
dwell away, banish, expel; to take away, remove.
वि-प्रवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, withdrawn, departed.
वि-प्रवासित, अस्, आ, अम्, banished, removed.

वि-प्रवास, अस्, m. dwelling at a distance, residence
in a foreign country, staying abroad.

वि-प्रवासन, अम्, n. banishment, expulsion;
residence abroad.

वि-प्रोषित, अस्, आ, अम् (वि-प्र-उषित), dwelling
abroad, absent, away from; banished.
—विप्रोषित-
भर्तृका, f. a woman whose husband or lover is
absent.

विप्रोषित वि-प्रोषित, &c. See under वि-
प्र-वस्, col. 2.

वि-प्रोष्य, ind. having dwelt abroad, having been
absent, returning after having been absent.

विप्रव्यध् वि-प्र-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति,
-व्यद्धुम्, to strike through, strike down.
वि-प्रविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, struck through, struck.

विप्रश्निका वि-प्रश्निका, f. (fr. rt. प्रछ् with
वि), a female fortune-teller.

विप्रसृ वि-प्र-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, &c., to
spread, be expanded or extended.

विप्रहीण वि-प्रहीण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. हा
with प्र and वि), deprived of, destitute of.

विप्रिय वि-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, unpleasant,
disagreeable, disliked, distasteful, unbeloved; (अम्),
n. offence, transgression.
—विप्रिय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
doing what is displeasing, acting unkindly, offensive.

विप्रुत वि-प्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = वि-प्लुत,
immersed, submerged; having torn or wounded
limbs, (Sāy. = विश्लिष्टावयव.)

विप्रुष् वि-प्रुष्, ट्, f. (also written वि-प्लुष्,
see rts. 1. प्रुष्, प्लुष्), a drop of water or other
liquid; a spot, mark, dot.
—विप्रुड्-ढोम, अस्, m.,
Ved. an expiatory offering designed to atone for the
drops of Soma accidentally let fall at a sacrifice.
—वि-
प्रुष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, filled with drops.

विप्रे वि-प्रे (-प्र-इ), cl. 2. P. -प्रैति, -प्रै-
तुम्, to go forth in different directions, depart in
different ways; to be dispersed or scattered.
वि-प्रेत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth, departed.

विप्रेक्ष् वि-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
-प्रेक्षते, -प्रेक्षितुम्, to look here and there,
look on all sides; to regard, consider.

विप्लु वि-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to
swim or float or drift in different directions, float
about, fluctuate, be submerged; to be dispersed or
scattered; to fall into disorder or confusion, become
disarranged or confused; to be lost or ruined, to come
to disgrace or dishonour: Caus. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to swim or float about, cause to drift hither
and thither; to make known, spread abroad, make
public, divulge; to bring to ruin or calamity; to
perplex, confuse, confound, (in this sense the form
वि-प्लवयति is found.)

वि-प्लव, अस्, m. floating or drifting about or in
different directions; confusion, perplexity, contra-
riety, opposition, perversity; trouble, disaster, evil,
calamity; sin, wickedness; the rust on a mirror
(Kirāt.
II. 26

); tumult, rapine, extortion; predatory
or devastating warfare, devastation; affray, scuffle,
disturbance; terrifying an enemy by shouts and
gestures; spreading abroad, divulging, (विप्लवं
गम्, to become known.)
—विप्लव-तस्, ind. in
consequence of misfortune, by reason of disturbance.

2. वि-प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, not having a vessel,
without a ship.

वि-प्लाव, अस्, m. causing tumult or disturbance,
devastating; deluging, inundating; a horse's canter
or gallop.

वि-प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, floating or drifting
about, falling into disorder.

वि-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to drift or swim about,
turned adrift, floated; spread abroad, divulged.

वि-प्लाव्य, ind. having caused to swim or float
about; having caused to be deluged or devastated,
having confused or disturbed; having divulged, hav-
ing made public or common, (applied in Manu

. to the teaching of the Veda to improper persons
or at improper seasons.)

वि-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned adrift, confounded,
disturbed, fallen into confusion, scattered, dispersed;
devastated, ravaged; ruined, disgraced, dishonoured,
lost, disappeared; overwhelmed; drowned, deluged,
bathed; obscured, dimmed, disfigured; depraved,
wicked, abandoned, dissolute, addicted to evil prac-
tices, guilty of lewdness or promiscuous intercourse;
contrary, adverse, averse.
—विप्लुत-नेत्र or वि-
प्लुत-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes bathed or
dimmed (with tears, joy, &c.).

विप्सा विप्सा, f. = वीप्सा, repetition, suc-
cession.

वीप्सा वीप्सा, f. (fr. the Desid. of व्य्-आप्,
q. v.), ‘the desire of pervading (with any property or
quality simultaneously or continuously),’ several or
successive order or series, the arrangement of things
or properties in regular succession or each by each,
repetition, the repetition of words to imply continu-
ous or successive action (e. g. वृक्षं वृक्षं
सिञ्चति, he waters tree after tree; प्रभुर् भूतम्
भूतम् अभि सर्व-प्राणिष्व् अस्ति, the supreme
being is in all living beings creature after creature;
cf. Pāṇ.
VIII. 1, 4

वि-परिभ्रंश, अस्, m. complete failure, mis-
carriage; loss, ruin.
वि-पर्यक्, ind. inversely.
वि-पीडम्, ind. without injury, mercifully.
विपुलय, Nom. P. विपुलयति, to extend, enlarge.

वि-प्रणाश, अस्, m. complete loss, total disap-
pearance.

वि-प्रतीप, अस्, आ, अम्, quite contrary or opposite,
obstinate, wilful, stubborn, hostile, unfriendly.
वि-प्रत्यय, अस्, m. want of confidence.

वि-प्रमाथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or trampling to
pieces, destroying.

वि-प्रमोक्ष, अस्, m. the being free from, free-
dom or release from.

वि-प्रमोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of liberating
one's self from, liberation from.

वि-प्रवाद, अस्, m. varying statement, disagree-
ment.

वि-प्रहाण, अम्, n. entire disappearance, total
loss.
वि-प्रेक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking round.
